##### Project general facts

One Crescent Palm by AHS Properties is an ultra-luxury residential landmark designed by Killa Design around the concept of villas in the sky. The building presents an exclusive collection of three- and four-bedroom penthouses, five-bedroom sky villas and six-bedroom sky mansions. Each curve of the wave-like facade is deliberately shaped to hold private pools and green pockets, giving the architecture an integrated, flowing character, while infinity-edge pools, double-height volumes and large terraces open towards the sea, Burj Al Arab and the city skyline.

Building amenities are designed around wellness, privacy and hospitality. Residents enjoy a world-class spa, infinity pools, a gym and yoga studio and direct beach access, alongside a residents' lounge, a screening room and a cigar lounge for relaxed social evenings. A round-the-clock luxury concierge, a dedicated concierge app and a dedicated chauffeur service complete a lifestyle reserved for a select few, with every service tailored to the comfort of owners and their guests.

Residences combine formal living and dining areas with a show kitchen and a separate back-of-house kitchen, a powder room and a master suite with its own lounge. Guest rooms, a laundry room and staff quarters support effortless daily living. Outdoor terraces feature a private pool, an outdoor dining area, a teppanyaki station and generous seating areas for entertaining. A private elevator serves each home, and residences are delivered with fitted kitchens, ready for the owner's own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is one of the world's most recognisable island communities, built in the shape of a palm tree with a long trunk, a fan of fronds and a protective crescent. The eastern crescent is lined with luxury hotels, beach clubs and fine dining venues, including Rixos The Palm, Taj Exotica Resort and Spa and Anantara The Palm, offering a resort-style setting with open views across the Arabian Gulf.

Atlantis The Palm and Nakheel Mall lie close by, while the Palm Monorail and the main trunk road connect residents with Sheikh Zayed Road. Burj Al Arab, Dubai Marina and Mall of the Emirates are a short drive away, and Dubai International Financial Centre and Dubai Mall are also within easy reach. Beaches, marinas, spas and restaurants keep everyday leisure close to home, and the waterfront boardwalk offers scenic walking and jogging routes along the shoreline.

Palm Jumeirah is a freehold destination and one of Dubai's most prestigious addresses for high-net-worth buyers. Limited supply of large-format beachfront homes, strong demand from international buyers and premium holiday rental potential support long-term value and resilient resale prospects. Its iconic status, established infrastructure and concentration of luxury hospitality keep the island attractive to both end users and investors seeking a trophy address.
